argument: The nine fragments must read as one continuous proof strip before they read as nine interface targets. Register lines, shared baseline, uneven spacing, and the long horizontal tension must carry the composition without chrome.

With labels, readout, controls, hint, and prose hidden, the first view must leave v044's wall, v045's slab, and v046's vessel. It should read as a misregistered print run, not a bar chart, card row, or decorative barcode.
The visitor must cross the strip and release. Pointer, touch, keyboard, and deterministic control paths must offer equivalent meaningful routes; no hover-only action may carry the work.
The moving correction must remain geometry-neutral. Only a travelled release with sufficient pressure may alter a different fragment; a short or weak trace must leave the ledger exact.
The source fragment must remain exactly unchanged while the wrong target answers. If the source dents, shifts, or merely receives a halo, the copy-error translation fails.
Travel and pressure must alter the generated target's phase, scale, angle, and registration scar. An opacity change or cursor trail is not material memory.
A press without crossing, a short drag, a weak drag, and a cancelled release must remain geometry-neutral. Release after the threshold is the only commit condition.
Four wrong placements must compound in one ledger. Lift must reconstruct the exact preceding strip and release must return to the deterministic seed.
Generated Canvas 2D register bands, proof fragments, phase bars, and overprints are the medium. No screenshot, imported illustration, external font, or decorative particle system may carry the work.
p5.brush is translated from material production into copy-error memory. Brushes, watercolor, hatching, grain, source palette, source composition, source code, examples, and API surface are refused.
